name: Coach screen shell: four panes, tabs, swipe, deep links
gap: Four panes and the segmented tablist are there, but there is no swipe between panes, no accent dot on Check-in when today is unanswered, and the deep link only accepts ?view=plan|setup — not check-in.

name: Chat error rows, retry, and paywall hand-off
gap: An error bubble with Try again renders and retry works, but it is only reachable from the dev switcher (no request can fail), and there is no rate-limit/paywall branch at all — no LOCKED.paywall(), no 'See plans'.

name: Reply parsing — structured action markers
gap: There is no reply-marker parser. The one structured action is the plan offer, and it is triggered by a regex on the question the user sent (/plan|block|program/), not by anything in the reply.

name: Action card — save a training split
gap: No split action card anywhere in the chat; nothing writes lk_splits from coach.

name: Action card — save a recipe / add ingredients to shopping
gap: No recipe card and no ADD TO SHOP; nothing writes lk_coachRecipes or the shopping list from coach.

name: Action card — create a goal
gap: No goal card; nothing writes lk_goals from coach.

name: Action card — log food
gap: No food card; nothing writes lk_fuelLog from coach.

name: Action card — log cardio (CoachCardioCard)
gap: No cardio card; nothing writes lk_history from coach.

name: Action card — save coaching instructions from chat
gap: Instructions can only be written in the Setup pane or by the interview; no chat card offers to save coaching instructions.

name: "SAVE ALL (N ACTIONS)"
gap: Only one action type exists in a reply, so there is nothing to save all of.

name: Shopping-list approval modal
gap: No ###SHOPPING_ADD### path and no approval modal; the only modals are bind-split and delete-plan.

name: Remembered-fact chip with Undo
gap: No remembered-fact chip in the thread. Memory is only added by hand in Setup (which does have its own Undo toast).

name: Setup pane — coaching style / persona
gap: Four styles (direct/encouraging/technical/brief) against v6's seven personas, and the style is stored but never changes a reply — replyFor ignores it.

name: Coach interview (six questions → AI-written instructions)
gap: Six questions, Back, a review step, stored answers and Escape all work, but the instructions are written by a local sentence builder (draftInstructions), not by a model — the sheet's own progress steps say 'Writing the instructions' for a string concat.

name: Plan pane — this week, overall progress, phase timeline
gap: Week-of-plan, phase timeline and per-target progress from lk_prs are all real, but 'overall' is plain elapsed time (week/weeks), not the 40% time + 60% targets blend, and there is no session-dots row comparing sessions since Monday to the split's training days.

name: Plan pane — phase/plan review prompt
gap: No 'Review with coach' card when a phase or the plan ends; planOver/phaseDone are not computed at all.
where: coach.html:1009 planBody (footer is adjust + delete only)

name: Daily check-in — the form
gap: Five 1-5 readings save to lk_feedback in the key's real shape, but the word anchors are two-ended labels rather than v6's per-step words, and there are no tags (CHECKIN_TAGS), no hoursSlept and no note field.

name: Check-in — the local coach response ("payoff card")
gap: Saving shows a toast only. There is no coachCheckinResponse: no baseline/red/amber branches, no wellbeing paragraph, no 'Talk about this' hand-off into Chat.

name: Check-in — 14-day dot row and day inspector
gap: No 14-day dot row and no day inspector. 'Recent' is five static rows of numbers that cannot be tapped.

name: Check-in — done-for-today state
gap: The status line says 'Saved for today' / 'Already checked in today. Saving replaces it.', but there is no per-day quota (N of M), no dot row and no inspector; lk_checkinPerDay is written by Settings and never read here.

name: Beta admin — code management
gap: There is no beta admin screen anywhere in the build — no codes list, no add/toggle, no lk_betaCodes.
where: not in 08-build (grep 'beta' hits only settings.html comments)

name: Beta admin — activity / AI logs / feedback tabs
gap: No activity / AI logs / feedback tabs; lk_betaLog and lk_betaAILog are never read or written.
